en.title: FORMING
en.subtitle: Scattered signals begin to take shape
en.meaning: A structure is emerging from differences, signals, or material that has not fully settled. It points to order in formation rather than a finished answer.
en.insight: The priority may be less about adding input and more about noticing what is taking shape.
en.prompt: What recently separate pieces are beginning to look connected?

en.title: FOCUS
en.subtitle: Finding what deserves weight among many possibilities
en.meaning: Attention and judgment are converging from many possibilities toward what deserves priority.
en.insight: Not everything needs equal attention; this reading emphasizes what deserves weight.
en.prompt: What most deserves your full attention now?

en.title: GROUNDING
en.subtitle: Giving the structure a basis that can hold it
en.meaning: A structure needs boundaries, resources, a carrier, or stable conditions before it can operate sustainably.
en.insight: This reading emphasizes what can actually hold the next stage, not simply moving faster.
en.prompt: What needs to become stable before other things can continue?

en.title: INTEGRATION
en.subtitle: Bringing separate parts into one workable whole
en.meaning: Several structures, demands, or reality layers need to be understood within one coherent frame.
en.insight: The issue may lie less in any single part than in how the parts work together.
en.prompt: Which two apparently separate parts need to be considered together?

en.title: EXPANSION
en.subtitle: A workable structure begins to extend outward
en.meaning: An established structure is gaining range, expression, reach, or usable space.
en.insight: Something is moving beyond potential and gaining room to enter a larger reality.
en.prompt: What is ready to be carried into a wider range?

en.title: RECONFIGURATION
en.subtitle: The old arrangement no longer fits; a new one is forming
en.meaning: Useful parts may remain, but their previous arrangement no longer supports current conditions.
en.insight: The answer may require a different arrangement rather than more effort.
en.prompt: What really needs to change: the parts themselves, or how they are arranged?

en.title: DEEPENING
en.subtitle: Moving from surface signals toward workable understanding
en.meaning: The value now lies in clearer recognition and interpretation rather than more surface input.
en.insight: This reading emphasizes understanding what is happening before rushing to the next move.
en.prompt: Which question, if genuinely understood, would simplify the others?

en.title: ORIENTATION
en.subtitle: Clarifying the next viable direction
en.meaning: The current structure needs a viable direction so attention, action, and resources stop moving separately.
en.insight: Sometimes the priority is not immediate action but knowing which direction is worth organizing toward.
en.prompt: If only one direction could move first, where would you place resources?

en.title: SEEKING
en.subtitle: The question still asks for a clearer answer
en.meaning: The runtime is driven by seeking, understanding, or locating what is not yet clear.
en.insight: An unresolved part continues to hold attention.
en.prompt: Are you looking for an answer, or for a more accurate question?

en.title: RESPONSE
en.subtitle: The system organizes a response after reality presents a signal
en.meaning: Momentum comes from feedback, changing conditions, or a demand that has entered the field.
en.insight: What drives movement may be a signal from reality that now requires a response.
en.prompt: Which signal actually requires your response now?

en.title: ADVANCE
en.subtitle: Direction has appeared and momentum begins to organize forward
en.meaning: Drive comes from initiation, execution, or bringing an organized priority into reality.
en.insight: When direction is clear enough, the next step moves naturally from understanding into action.
en.prompt: What smallest action would genuinely move the structure forward?

en.title: CORRECTION
en.subtitle: Change begins with calibration after a mismatch becomes visible
en.meaning: Reality feedback is asking for adjustment in weight, relationships, or operation.
en.insight: Change may be driven not by failure, but by seeing what no longer fits.
en.prompt: What feedback has appeared more than once without changing the way you operate?

en.title: COMPLETION
en.subtitle: An open structure continues to ask for real completion
en.meaning: The runtime is pulled by responsibilities, processes, relationships, or structures that remain open.
en.insight: Some momentum comes from the fact that something remains unfinished.
en.prompt: What, if truly completed, would release the most space?

en.title: BREAKTHROUGH
en.subtitle: The old constraint has become too narrow and a new possibility needs room
en.meaning: Momentum comes from expansion, mutation, or an old structure that can no longer contain new conditions.
en.insight: Sometimes change needs a clear discontinuity rather than incremental repair.
en.prompt: Which constraint no longer protects the structure and now prevents something new from forming?

en.title: STEWARDSHIP
en.subtitle: Some momentum comes from carrying what is worth sustaining
en.meaning: Drive comes from structuring, protection, responsibility, or carrying what remains workable into the next cycle.
en.insight: Your continued investment may come not from impulse but from something genuinely worth sustaining.
en.prompt: Of what you are carrying, what is truly yours to continue holding?

en.title: CALLING
en.subtitle: A direction keeps drawing attention and investment
en.meaning: This card points to a persistent directional attraction. Even before the reason is fully understood, attention, curiosity, investment, or imagination keeps returning to the same direction. Calling does not prove that direction is correct; it means the theme is persistent enough to deserve observation and validation rather than dismissal.
en.insight: Some directions keep returning not because they are fully understood, but because their attraction remains real.
en.prompt: What direction keeps drawing your attention across different stages, and what real-world evidence supports continuing to explore it?

en.title: ORGANIZE
en.subtitle: Turning scattered material into workable structure
en.meaning: The capacity to organize direction, position, resources, or differences into a workable structure.
en.insight: One available capacity is making complex material more ordered.
en.prompt: What most needs organizing before it needs solving?

en.title: DISCERN
en.subtitle: Recognizing the distinctions that actually matter
en.meaning: The capacity for recognition, interpretation, comparison, and workable understanding.
en.insight: Understanding and discernment can turn mixed signals into clearer judgment.
en.prompt: Which distinction, once clear, would change your understanding of the whole situation?

en.title: CONNECT
en.subtitle: Creating workable relationships between separate realities
en.meaning: The capacity to coordinate response across relationships, shared structures, and different positions.
en.insight: Some problems are less about missing capacity than about how things connect.
en.prompt: Which connection, if redesigned, would make the whole system lighter?

en.title: EXPRESS
en.subtitle: Making internal organization perceivable and communicable
en.meaning: The capacity to express, externalize, explain, and bring internal structure into shared reality.
en.insight: You can turn internal organization into something perceivable and communicable.
en.prompt: What needs to be made clear before it can enter real interaction?

en.title: HOLD
en.subtitle: Keeping what matters viable under pressure and constraint
en.meaning: The capacity to maintain viability, protect necessary structure, and continue under constraint.
en.insight: Sometimes capacity means knowing what must be held, not what must be added.
en.prompt: What is worth continuing to hold, and what should be released or redistributed?

en.title: BUILD
en.subtitle: Turning organized response into sustainable structure
en.meaning: The capacity to execute, organize resources, and turn a response into concrete structure.
en.insight: An available strength is turning understanding into something concrete and operational.
en.prompt: What could become a small but genuinely workable version?

en.title: ADAPT
en.subtitle: Changing method in response to reality
en.meaning: This card represents the capacity to change method in response to real conditions. When an existing path stops fitting, angle, sequence, rhythm, or tools can be adjusted without abandoning the underlying direction. Adaptation preserves what matters while changing how it is realized.
en.insight: Real stability is not repeating one method forever, but finding another effective way when conditions change.
en.prompt: Does the goal itself need to change, or only the way it is being pursued?

en.title: TRANSFORM
en.subtitle: Turning pressure and change into a new operational form
en.meaning: The capacity to mobilize drive and move an existing form into a different way of operating.
en.insight: You can direct accumulated pressure and momentum toward structural change instead of merely carrying it.
en.prompt: Which pressure could become energy for changing the structure itself?

en.title: OVERLOAD
en.subtitle: The load begins to exceed available capacity
en.meaning: A capacity risk that can appear when activation, holding, or execution remains too high.
en.insight: The tension is not about effort alone, but whether the load exceeds sustainable capacity.
en.prompt: What now needs recovery, reduction, or redistribution?

en.title: PULL
en.subtitle: Two directions are gaining weight at the same time
en.meaning: Potential competing pull between drivers, responsibilities, or reality demands.
en.insight: When two directions both deserve response, the difficulty is how to allocate weight.
en.prompt: Which two directions are asking for attention, and do they truly need to move at the same time?

en.title: STALL
en.subtitle: The structure exists, but transition is not happening
en.meaning: Constraints, boundaries, or incomplete conditions may keep the runtime in place.
en.insight: Sometimes direction exists but an entry condition, capability, or support has not opened.
en.prompt: Is action missing, or are the conditions that allow action missing?

en.title: DISPERSION
en.subtitle: Attention and resources are split across similar priorities
en.meaning: A potential dispersion of resources and attention when several drivers carry similar weight.
en.insight: When too many directions gain weight, the issue may be concentration rather than correctness.
en.prompt: What could remain still for now so one important thing can finish?

en.title: COMPRESSION
en.subtitle: Too much is being held inside limited space
en.meaning: Tension created when constraints, holding, or boundaries concentrate many demands into limited capacity.
en.insight: When space narrows, adding more may be more dangerous than reducing.
en.prompt: What could leave in exchange for more operating space?

en.title: LOOP
en.subtitle: Feedback returns repeatedly without producing real update
en.meaning: Feedback, continuity, or unresolved structures may form a repeating runtime.
en.insight: Repetition is not necessarily failure, but it may show that the current response is not changing the structure.
en.prompt: When this issue returns, what must be different from last time?

en.title: WITHDRAWAL
en.subtitle: The system narrows new input and connection to protect stability
en.meaning: This card describes a system reducing input, connection, and openness to avoid further load, conflict, or uncertainty. Some contraction can be protective, but if it keeps expanding, boundaries that once preserved stability can become restrictions that block new resources, relationships, information, or change.
en.insight: Protection can preserve stability, but when it keeps expanding it can also close off new input and possibility.
en.prompt: Which protective moves are still necessary, and which have begun to restrict useful new input?

en.title: DRAIN
en.subtitle: The runtime loses energy or support while continuing to occupy capacity
en.meaning: The continuing cost that can arise as energy, field support, or available capacity declines.
en.insight: When support declines, maintaining the same intensity can increase recovery cost.
en.prompt: What no longer deserves to be maintained at the same intensity?

en.title: CONTAINER
en.subtitle: Complex material needs a stable enough container
en.meaning: Environmental conditions of containment, holding, and keeping necessary structure together.
en.insight: Support may come not from more stimulation but from a space that can hold what matters.
en.prompt: What kind of space helps you hold things steadily instead of constantly reacting?

en.title: BOUNDARY
en.subtitle: Clear limits show the runtime where to stop and stabilize
en.meaning: Field conditions that stop, distinguish, delimit, and stabilize boundaries.
en.insight: Support may come from clear range rather than total openness.
en.prompt: Which boundary, if made clear, would make the whole environment easier to operate in?

en.title: COLLABORATION
en.subtitle: Different positions create better capacity through complementarity
en.meaning: Support formed through coordination, differentiated roles, and shared holding across relationships.
en.insight: Support is not necessarily more people; it can be clearer roles and complementarity.
en.prompt: What would become lighter if it moved to a more appropriate role or position?

en.title: EXCHANGE
en.subtitle: Resources, response, and value need reciprocal movement
en.meaning: Conditions in which change proceeds through exchange, response, and reciprocal movement.
en.insight: A supportive field allows real movement between contribution and response rather than one-way depletion.
en.prompt: Where is the need not more effort, but a better exchange?

en.title: RHYTHM
en.subtitle: A sustainable pace matters more than continuous acceleration
en.meaning: A field rhythm that supports change through movement, circulation, and adaptation around obstacles.
en.insight: Some structures stabilize only when movement, pause, and recovery can alternate.
en.prompt: Does your reality need more speed, or a better rhythm?

en.title: SPACE
en.subtitle: Unoccupied space is itself a resource
en.meaning: The margin needed for range, reach, and organizational space to expand.
en.insight: Not every space needs filling; margin gives new structure somewhere to appear.
en.prompt: What space, if left unassigned for now, would let something new emerge?

en.title: CALIBRATION
en.subtitle: The environment supports accuracy through ongoing adjustment
en.meaning: A field that becomes supportive through gradual entry, feedback, and distributed influence.
en.insight: Supportive conditions may be formed through repeated small adjustments rather than found all at once.
en.prompt: Which small adjustment is most likely to improve the whole operating experience?

en.title: SUPPORT
en.subtitle: When conditions are present, the structure can operate with less friction
en.meaning: Conditions that open an entry, provide resources, or make operation more available.
en.insight: Real support lowers operating cost rather than merely adding encouragement.
en.prompt: Which condition, if present, would noticeably reduce how hard you need to push?

en.title: OPENING
en.subtitle: An entry is becoming possible
en.meaning: This card represents the opening position of the ECR baseline activation window.
en.insight: The structure is at a point where operation can begin, but this does not mean it already has.
en.prompt: Which conditions have only just become possible?

en.title: ACTIVATING
en.subtitle: The structure crosses entry and begins operating
en.meaning: This card represents the ECR baseline window crossing its entry threshold and beginning to operate.
en.insight: This card marks movement from possibility into actual activation.
en.prompt: What is no longer only an idea and is beginning to show operating signals?

en.title: GAINING WEIGHT
en.subtitle: The operating pattern begins to gain enough weight
en.meaning: This card represents the motion pattern gaining enough weight in the ECR baseline window to shape what comes next.
en.insight: A pattern is becoming more influential, while reality feedback is still needed to see how it develops.
en.prompt: What is influencing your next step more clearly than before?

en.title: AMPLIFYING
en.subtitle: Surrounding conditions make the active pattern more visible
en.meaning: This card represents field amplification in the ECR baseline activation window.
en.insight: A pattern is being strengthened by surrounding conditions and becomes easier to notice.
en.prompt: What has become especially visible because the surrounding conditions changed?

en.title: ALIGNMENT
en.subtitle: Conditions temporarily align with lower friction
en.meaning: This card represents an alignment position in the ECR baseline activation window.
en.insight: This card represents a period in which several conditions can work together more easily.
en.prompt: What is most worth advancing while conditions are aligned?

en.title: OVERAMPLIFICATION
en.subtitle: Activation intensity begins to exceed a balanced range
en.meaning: This card represents over-amplification in the ECR baseline activation window, where structural cost may rise.
en.insight: This card is not a bad omen; it marks that more activation may no longer mean better operation.
en.prompt: What is beginning to lose effectiveness because there is too much of it?

en.title: DECAY
en.subtitle: The active configuration begins losing energy or field support
en.meaning: This card represents activation decay in the ECR baseline window.
en.insight: Some runtimes are not failing; they are naturally losing available support.
en.prompt: What no longer needs to be maintained at the same intensity?

en.title: CLOSURE
en.subtitle: The current window is closing and approaching transition
en.meaning: This card represents temporal closure in the ECR baseline window and an approach toward configuration transition.
en.insight: Closure is not emptiness; it makes room for another configuration.
en.prompt: What now deserves a proper ending instead of being carried into the next cycle?

zh-Hans.title: 成形
zh-Hans.subtitle: 散落的线索开始拥有轮廓
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表一个结构正从差异、线索或尚未定形的内容中出现。它强调「形成中的秩序」，而不是已经完成的答案。
zh-Hans.insight: 现在最重要的，不一定是继续增加资料，而是看见什么正在逐渐成形。
zh-Hans.prompt: 最近有哪些原本零散的东西，开始显得彼此有关？

zh-Hans.title: 聚焦
zh-Hans.subtitle: 从许多可能中找出真正值得放大的部分
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表注意力与判断正在从多个可能收束到一个更值得优先处理的主题。
zh-Hans.insight: 不是每件事都需要同时处理；这次读取更强调把权重放到真正关键的位置。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在最需要被你认真放大的，究竟是哪一件事？

zh-Hans.title: 扎根
zh-Hans.subtitle: 让结构找到可以长期承载它的基础
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表结构需要边界、资源、载体或稳定条件，才能从想法变成可持续运行。
zh-Hans.insight: 这次读取强调的不是更快，而是先确认什么能够真正承载接下来的运行。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在有什么必须先稳定下来，其他事情才有空间继续？

zh-Hans.title: 整合
zh-Hans.subtitle: 把分开的部分重新放进同一个整体
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表多个结构、需求或现实层面需要被放进同一个更完整的框架中理解。
zh-Hans.insight: 真正的问题可能不在任何单一部分，而在这些部分怎样一起运作。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪两个看似分开的部分，其实需要被一起考虑？

zh-Hans.title: 展开
zh-Hans.subtitle: 已有结构开始有空间向外延伸
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表已经形成的结构开始增加范围、表达、触达或可用空间。
zh-Hans.insight: 有些东西已经不再只是潜力，而开始具备进入更大现实的条件。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么已经准备好被带到更大的范围里？

zh-Hans.title: 重构
zh-Hans.subtitle: 旧排列已经不足，新的组合正在形成
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表既有结构仍有可用部分，但原来的组合已经无法继续支持新的条件。
zh-Hans.insight: 问题未必需要更多努力，也可能需要换掉原本的组织方式。
zh-Hans.prompt: 目前真正需要改变的，是内容本身，还是它们之间的排列方式？

zh-Hans.title: 深化
zh-Hans.subtitle: 从表面讯号进入更可用的理解
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表当前价值来自更准确的辨识、解释与理解，而不是增加更多表面讯号。
zh-Hans.insight: 这次读取更强调理解发生了什么，而不是急着决定下一步。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪一个问题真正理解以后，会让其他问题也变得简单？

zh-Hans.title: 定向
zh-Hans.subtitle: 确认下一步真正朝哪里走
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表当前结构需要一个可行方向，让注意、行动与资源不再各自移动。
zh-Hans.insight: 有些时候最重要的不是立刻行动，而是知道下一步值得朝哪个方向组织。
zh-Hans.prompt: 如果只能选择一个方向先前进，你会把资源放在哪里？

zh-Hans.title: 寻找
zh-Hans.subtitle: 问题仍在要求更清楚的答案
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表运行由寻找、理解或定位尚未清楚的部分推动。
zh-Hans.insight: 尚未解决的部分持续拉住注意力。
zh-Hans.prompt: 你现在寻找的是答案，还是一个更准确的问题？

zh-Hans.title: 回应
zh-Hans.subtitle: 现实出现讯号后，系统开始组织回应
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表动力来自反馈、条件变化或一个已经进入场域的需求。
zh-Hans.insight: 真正推动你的，可能是现实已经给出了需要回应的讯号。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在真正需要你回应的讯号是什么？

zh-Hans.title: 推进
zh-Hans.subtitle: 方向已经出现，力量开始向前组织
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表驱动力来自启动、执行或把已经形成的优先级带入现实。
zh-Hans.insight: 当方向足够清楚时，下一步会自然从理解进入行动。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪一个最小行动，能够真正让结构向前？

zh-Hans.title: 修正
zh-Hans.subtitle: 偏差被看见以后，改变由校准开始
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表现实反馈正在要求调整权重、关系或运行方式。
zh-Hans.insight: 推动改变的，不一定是失败，而可能是你已经看见哪里不再适配。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么反馈已经出现多次，却还没有真正改变你的做法？

zh-Hans.title: 完成
zh-Hans.subtitle: 未关闭的结构持续要求一个真正的结束
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表运行被未关闭的责任、流程、关系或结构持续牵引。
zh-Hans.insight: 有些动力来自「还没有完成」本身。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么真正完成以后，会立刻释放最多空间？

zh-Hans.title: 突破
zh-Hans.subtitle: 旧限制已经太窄，需要打开新的可能
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表动力来自扩张、突变或旧结构无法继续容纳新条件。
zh-Hans.insight: 有时改变不是渐进修补，而是需要一个足够明确的断点。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么限制已经不再保护你，而是在阻止新的结构出现？

zh-Hans.title: 承担
zh-Hans.subtitle: 有些动力来自持续承载值得留下的东西
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表动力来自结构化、保护、责任或把仍可运行的部分带入下一轮。
zh-Hans.insight: 你持续投入的原因，可能不是冲动，而是有些东西确实值得被继续承载。
zh-Hans.prompt: 你正在承担的东西里，哪些真的属于你继续承载？

zh-Hans.title: 召唤
zh-Hans.subtitle: 某个方向持续吸引注意与投入
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示当前动力来自一种持续存在的方向性吸引。即使尚未能完全解释为什么，注意、好奇、投入或想象仍不断回到同一个方向。召唤并不证明这个方向一定正确，它只是说明：这个主题具有足够持续性，值得被认真观察和验证，而不是立即忽略。
zh-Hans.insight: 有些方向之所以不断回来，并不是因为已经想清楚，而是它持续保持真实吸引力。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么方向总是在不同阶段重新吸引你的注意？现实中有没有证据支持它值得继续探索？

zh-Hans.title: 组织
zh-Hans.subtitle: 把分散内容重新排列成可工作的结构
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表把方向、位置、资源或差异重新组织成可操作结构的能力。
zh-Hans.insight: 你的可用能力之一，是让复杂内容出现次序。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在什么最需要先被整理，而不是立刻被解决？

zh-Hans.title: 洞察
zh-Hans.subtitle: 从讯号中辨认真正重要的差异
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表识别、解释、比较与形成可用理解的能力。
zh-Hans.insight: 你可以通过理解与辨识，把混杂的讯号变成更清楚的判断。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么差异一旦看清楚，会改变你对整件事的理解？

zh-Hans.title: 连接
zh-Hans.subtitle: 让分开的现实之间出现可工作的关系
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表在关系、共同结构与不同位置之间协调回应的能力。
zh-Hans.insight: 有些问题不是缺少能力，而是需要更好的连接方式。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪一个连接如果重新设计，会让整个系统轻很多？

zh-Hans.title: 表达
zh-Hans.subtitle: 把内部组织转成他人或自己能够看见的形式
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表表达、输出、说明与让内部结构进入共享现实的能力。
zh-Hans.insight: 你拥有把内部理解转成可被感知与沟通形式的能力。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么需要被说清楚，才能真正进入现实互动？

zh-Hans.title: 承载
zh-Hans.subtitle: 在限制与压力下仍保留必要的结构
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表维持可生存性、保护必要结构与在约束中持续运行的能力。
zh-Hans.insight: 真正的能力有时不是继续增加，而是知道什么必须被稳稳承载。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在什么值得继续承载，什么应该被释放或重新分配？

zh-Hans.title: 建构
zh-Hans.subtitle: 把已经组织的回应变成可持续的现实结构
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表执行、资源组织与把回应落实为具体结构的能力。
zh-Hans.insight: 你可用的力量在于把理解变成具体、可运行的东西。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么可以被做成一个足够小、但真实可运行的版本？

zh-Hans.title: 调整
zh-Hans.subtitle: 依据现实变化改变方法
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表根据现实条件改变方法的能力。当原有路径不再适用，系统可以根据反馈重新调整角度、顺序、节奏或工具，而不需要彻底否定原本目标。调整的价值在于保留方向，同时改变实现方式，使结构能够继续适应变化中的现实。
zh-Hans.insight: 真正稳定的能力并不是永远维持同一种做法，而是在环境变化时仍能找到新的有效方式。
zh-Hans.prompt: 当前需要改变的是目标本身，还是只需要改变实现目标的方法？

zh-Hans.title: 转化
zh-Hans.subtitle: 把压力与变化转成新的运行形式
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表动员驱动力并让原有形式进入不同运行方式的能力。
zh-Hans.insight: 你可以把累积的压力与动力导向结构变化，而不只是继续承受。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪一股压力其实可以被转成改变结构的力量？

zh-Hans.title: 过载
zh-Hans.subtitle: 可用容量开始小于正在承担的运行
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表结构在持续激活、承载或执行时可能出现的容量风险。
zh-Hans.insight: 需要留意的不是努力够不够，而是承载是否已经超过可持续范围。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么已经开始需要恢复、减少或重新分配？

zh-Hans.title: 拉扯
zh-Hans.subtitle: 两个方向同时取得重量
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表多个驱动力、责任或现实要求之间可能出现的竞争性牵引。
zh-Hans.insight: 当两个方向都值得回应时，真正困难的是如何分配权重。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪两个方向正在同时要求你的注意？它们真的需要同时进行吗？

zh-Hans.title: 迟滞
zh-Hans.subtitle: 结构存在，但转换没有发生
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表限制、边界或尚未完成的条件可能让运行停留在同一位置。
zh-Hans.insight: 有时候不是没有方向，而是某个入口、能力或条件还没有真正打开。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在缺的是行动，还是行动能够发生的条件？

zh-Hans.title: 分散
zh-Hans.subtitle: 注意与资源被多个相近优先级切开
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表多个驱动力权重接近时可能形成的资源与注意分散。
zh-Hans.insight: 如果太多方向同时取得权重，问题可能不是选择错误，而是没有足够集中。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在有哪些事情可以暂时不动，让一件真正重要的事完成？

zh-Hans.title: 压缩
zh-Hans.subtitle: 太多内容被要求留在有限空间内
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表限制、承载或边界让多个需求集中在有限容量中的张力。
zh-Hans.insight: 当空间越来越小，继续塞入更多内容可能比删减更危险。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么其实可以退出，换取更大的运行空间？

zh-Hans.title: 反复
zh-Hans.subtitle: 反馈持续回来，却没有形成真正更新
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表反馈、持续性或未关闭问题可能形成重复运行。
zh-Hans.insight: 重复不一定代表失败，但它可能表示现有处理方式没有改变结构。
zh-Hans.prompt: 这个问题再次出现时，什么必须和上一次做得不一样？

zh-Hans.title: 封闭
zh-Hans.subtitle: 为了保护稳定，系统逐渐减少新的输入与连接
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表系统为了避免进一步负荷、冲突或不确定性，开始减少输入、连接与开放程度。适度收紧有时是必要的保护，但当这个过程持续扩大，原本用于维持稳定的边界可能逐渐变成限制，使新的资源、关系、讯息或变化难以进入。
zh-Hans.insight: 保护本来可以维持稳定，但当保护持续扩大，也可能逐渐关闭新的输入与可能性。
zh-Hans.prompt: 目前有哪些保护动作仍然有必要，哪些已经从保护变成了限制新的输入？

zh-Hans.title: 耗散
zh-Hans.subtitle: 运行失去能量或支持，却仍持续占用容量
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表能量、场域支持或可用容量下降时的持续成本。
zh-Hans.insight: 当支持开始下降，继续维持原来的强度会让恢复成本增加。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么已经不再值得以原来的强度继续维持？

zh-Hans.title: 容器
zh-Hans.subtitle: 复杂内容需要一个足够稳定的承载空间
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表稳定容器、承载与保持必要结构的环境条件。
zh-Hans.insight: 支持你的条件可能不是更多刺激，而是一个能把重要东西稳稳放住的空间。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么样的空间会让你更容易把事情放稳，而不是一直应付？

zh-Hans.title: 边界
zh-Hans.subtitle: 清楚的界线让运行知道在哪里停止与稳定
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表停止、区分、界定与稳定边界的场域条件。
zh-Hans.insight: 适合你的支持不一定是完全开放，而可能是范围足够清楚。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么界线一旦说清楚，会让整个环境更容易运作？

zh-Hans.title: 协作
zh-Hans.subtitle: 不同位置通过分工与互补形成更好的承载
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表关系与共同结构通过协调、角色差异和共享承载形成支持。
zh-Hans.insight: 支持不一定来自更多人，而是来自更清楚的角色与互补。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪一部分如果交给更合适的位置，你会立刻轻很多？

zh-Hans.title: 交换
zh-Hans.subtitle: 资源、回应与价值需要保持双向流动
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表通过交换、回应与相互运动形成变化的条件。
zh-Hans.insight: 适合的场域会让投入与回应之间存在真实流动，而不是单向消耗。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪里需要的不是更多投入，而是更好的交换方式？

zh-Hans.title: 节律
zh-Hans.subtitle: 可持续速度比持续加速更重要
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表通过流动、循环与绕开阻力来支持变化的环境节律。
zh-Hans.insight: 有些结构只有在允许移动、停顿与恢复交替时才真正稳定。
zh-Hans.prompt: 你的现实现在需要加速，还是需要重新找回节奏？

zh-Hans.title: 留白
zh-Hans.subtitle: 未被占满的空间本身就是运行资源
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表扩大范围、触达与组织空间所需要的现实余量。
zh-Hans.insight: 并不是所有空间都需要被填满；余量让新的结构有地方出现。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么空间如果暂时不被安排，会让新的东西有机会出现？

zh-Hans.title: 校准
zh-Hans.subtitle: 环境通过持续微调与反馈支持更准确的运行
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表通过渐进进入、反馈与分布式影响让环境逐步适配。
zh-Hans.insight: 理想条件不一定一次找到，而可以通过不断的小调整逐渐形成。
zh-Hans.prompt: 哪一个小调整最可能明显改善整个运行感受？

zh-Hans.title: 支持
zh-Hans.subtitle: 条件到位时，结构能以较低摩擦开始运行
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌代表能够打开入口、提供资源或让结构更容易进入运行的条件。
zh-Hans.insight: 真正的支持会降低运行成本，而不是只是增加鼓励。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么条件一旦存在，你会明显不需要那么用力？

zh-Hans.title: 开启
zh-Hans.subtitle: 入口刚刚出现
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于入口打开阶段。
zh-Hans.insight: 结构处在可以开始进入运行的位置，但尚不等于已经发生。
zh-Hans.prompt: 现在有哪些条件只是刚刚变得可能？

zh-Hans.title: 启动
zh-Hans.subtitle: 结构越过入口，开始进入运行
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口越过入口阈值并开始运行。
zh-Hans.insight: 这张牌代表运行已经从可能性向实际启动移动。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么已经不只是想法，而开始出现实际运行讯号？

zh-Hans.title: 成势
zh-Hans.subtitle: 运行模式开始取得足够权重
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口中的运动模式开始取得足够权重，能够影响下一步。
zh-Hans.insight: 某个模式正在变得更有影响力，但仍需要现实反馈确认它如何发展。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么正在比之前更明显地影响你的下一步？

zh-Hans.title: 放大
zh-Hans.subtitle: 周围条件让活动模式变得更明显
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于场域放大阶段。
zh-Hans.insight: 这张牌表示某个模式在周围条件中被增强，因此更容易被看见。
zh-Hans.prompt: 最近什么因为环境变化而变得特别明显？

zh-Hans.title: 对齐
zh-Hans.subtitle: 条件暂时形成较低摩擦的组合
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于条件对齐阶段。
zh-Hans.insight: 这张牌代表多个条件暂时比较容易一起工作。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么事情在条件对齐时最值得优先推进？

zh-Hans.title: 过度放大
zh-Hans.subtitle: 激活强度开始超过较平衡范围
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于激活过度放大阶段，结构成本可能提高。
zh-Hans.insight: 这张牌不是坏预兆，而是在提醒：更多并不一定继续带来更好。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么正在因为「太多」而开始失去原本的效果？

zh-Hans.title: 回落
zh-Hans.subtitle: 活动配置开始失去可用能量或场域支持
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于激活回落阶段。
zh-Hans.insight: 有些运行不是失败，而是已经开始自然失去支持。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么已经可以不用再维持原来的强度？

zh-Hans.title: 收束
zh-Hans.subtitle: 当前窗口正在关闭，并接近结构转换
zh-Hans.meaning: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于时间性收束位置，并接近配置转换。
zh-Hans.insight: 结束不是空白，而是为下一种配置腾出位置。
zh-Hans.prompt: 什么已经值得好好结束，而不是继续拖进下一轮？
